changes: !! IMPORTANT !! ox_inventory and qs-inventory users: replace the hunting_bait, hunting_trap, portable_campfire, binoculars, hunting_encyclopedia and cooked meat item definitions with the ones in INVENTORY_ITEMS (on ox_inventory, remove the client export block and add consume = 0), otherwise these items will not work.
Make sure to update lyre_bridge alongside this resource (2.1.0 or newer is required).
Fixed hunting animals freezing or standing still for minutes, especially with several players around.
Shop, payments, missions, tournaments, traps and cooking are now fully validated by the server, and cooked meat can now be eaten.
Make sure to update lyre_bridge alongside this resource. The previous release was broken.
New Lyre Scripts structure: install and start lyre_bridge before this resource.
lyre_bridge is open source and is not included in Granted Assets ZIPs; download it here: https://github.com/lyrescripts/lyre_bridge
Inventory usable items and framework compatibility now go through lyre_bridge.
INVENTORY_ITEMS is no longer shipped as a separate folder; add the documented items to your inventory from the new release package/docs.
Release package cleaned and simplified; compare your old config with the new config before updating.
